_comment: The declared mutation contract for the G-3 negative-control harness.
Owner ruling 2026-08-25 (G-3 negative-control exception): where a guard was
written after the defect was already remediated, and no defective tree is
recoverable from repository history, the VERIFIED IN CI rung may be
satisfied by a negative control instead of a historical pre-fix red.
Each entry reintroduces the EXACT defect condition of its finding by removing
or re-creating the exact object the committed migration created or dropped,
and declares the exact assertions of the existing suite that must then fail.
The harness requires SET EQUALITY: an undeclared FAIL is fatal, and a
declared FAIL that does not occur is fatal.
Restoration is always by re-applying the committed migration UNMODIFIED.
No hand-authored inverse migration exists anywhere in this design.
This produces SYNTHETIC PRE-FIX-EQUIVALENT CI EVIDENCE. It is not historical
pre-fix evidence and must never be recorded as such. The real QA BEFORE->AFTER
evidence is a separate rung (VERIFIED LIVE), obtained at commit 2a8d0b6.
WRK-02 / WKA-02 is deliberately absent: its defect is client-side (a swap
inheriting set identities) and no schema mutation can express it. Its
negative control is Dart-layer and is not designed yet.
